base_candidates_ranked.reason: The PRIDE metadata and methods describe a DDA experiment (top 10 precursors) using TAP-MS for protein-protein interaction identification. While TMT is mentioned in a separate section of the paper, the specific PRIDE dataset PXD048215 describes TAP samples processed by in-gel digestion and DDA without mentioning isobaric labels for these specific samples.

The publication text describes a separate 'TMT11plex labeling and phosphopeptide analysis' using Maxquant and limma, but the PRIDE metadata for PXD048215 specifically details TAP-MS of TLK1 fragments without TMT labeling.
